reason: The complete batch and all 50 listed consumer paths were reviewed. Round 1 is the final review; unresolved domain and proof-presentation defects require owner resolution.

findings.reason: On the edge def-qft-qed-gauge-data -> lem-qft-qed-dirac-gauge-current, the supplier defines fields on an open U, while the consumer states ψ:R⁴→C⁴ and integrates variations over R⁴ without declaring a's domain. Specify a_a:R⁴→R (and the gauge parameter on R⁴), or formulate all fields and integrals on the same U. The downstream pthm-qft-qed-classical-coupling re-derives the variation on U, so no consumer-side change is indicated there.

The Statement's identification u(k)=s(p)/√(2ω) is not well-defined for a quotient class [s(p)]∈p⊥/Cp: changing its representative by cp changes the right side. State the quotient map T_p[ε]=ε_sp−nε⁰ from lem-qft-photon-null-quotient and use u=T_p[s(p)]/√(2ω), consistently with proof step 3.1. The affected action uses in post-qft-free-photon-model and pthm-qft-photon-physical-properties were checked.

Proof step 3.1 says derivatives of a test function have the same support as the test function. This is false in general; their support is contained in the original support. That containment suffices for the causal-support conclusion. The downstream local-Weyl and local-observables uses were checked.
